node.title: Tegrity.AI
node.summary: Tegrity.AI is an applied research, engineering and pre-standardization group of The Integral Management Society , a Swiss non-profit association based in Geneva. It advances AI Integrity Management through research, architecture, the review and development of standards, and technology for the common good.
